# pele.wiki

> Independent site with live demos and notes on Pele, the open-source Mermaid renderer by kepano (Steph Ango, CEO of Obsidian), built for Obsidian. Pele turns Mermaid diagram text into themeable SVG, synchronously, with zero dependencies. Official docs: https://pele.run · source: https://github.com/obsidianmd/pele (MIT) · npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/pele

Key facts:
- Install: `npm install pele`. Use: `import { render } from 'pele'; const { svg } = render(mermaidText)`. In a browser, `mount(element, text)` draws into an element, reads fonts from CSS and redraws when the element's width changes.
- Pele reads Mermaid syntax (it targets Mermaid 12.1.0) and supports every diagram type built into Mermaid 12.1.0: 32 kinds plus `info`. Its layout and look are its own, so diagrams do not look identical to Mermaid.js. Mermaid themes and themeVariables do not apply; colours come from CSS variables.
- Official figures (pele.run): about 230 kB gzip vs 1.6 MB for Mermaid.js; 0.05–0.3 ms per render vs 6–82 ms; 0 direct dependencies vs 23.
- Theming: CSS variables such as --pele-bg, --pele-fg, --pele-line, --pele-surface, --pele-border, --pele-accent, --pele-font, --pele-radius and --pele-series-1 to --pele-series-8. Colour changes apply without re-rendering.
- Narrow screens: pass maxWidth (mount does this for you); below 640 px a left-to-right flowchart can switch to top-to-bottom instead of shrinking.
- Safety: output has no scripts, event handlers or HTML labels; javascript:, data: and vbscript: links are always blocked; limits of 50,000 source characters, 4,000,000 SVG characters and 5,000 flowchart edges.
- Smaller bundles: `pele/core` + `register()` for chosen types, or `pele/lazy` + `renderAsync()` to load types on demand.
- When to keep Mermaid.js: you need its exact look, JavaScript click callbacks, or plugins such as ZenUML.
- pele.wiki is not affiliated with Obsidian or kepano; it is made by En Dash Consulting (https://endash.us). Demos use pele 1.6.0 and Mermaid.js 12.1.0.

## Live demos
- [Live demos of Pele](https://pele.wiki/): Live demos of Pele, kepano's Mermaid renderer, running next to Mermaid.js in your browser: typing, streaming, theming, narrow screens, 200 diagrams, untrusted input. (markdown: https://pele.wiki/md/index.md)
- [Streaming](https://pele.wiki/pages/stream.html): Demo: a Mermaid diagram arrives in chunks, as from an AI model. Pele redraws on each chunk; Mermaid.js catches up in jumps. (markdown: https://pele.wiki/md/stream.md)
- [Theming](https://pele.wiki/pages/theme-lab.html): Demo: recolour Pele diagrams with CSS variables, with no redraw. Mermaid.js redraws for every change. (markdown: https://pele.wiki/md/theme-lab.md)
- [Narrow screens](https://pele.wiki/pages/phone.html): Demo: narrow the viewport. Pele changes a wide flowchart to top-to-bottom so the text stays readable; Mermaid.js scales the drawing down. (markdown: https://pele.wiki/md/phone.md)
- [200 diagrams on one page](https://pele.wiki/pages/docs-page.html): Demo: 200 Mermaid diagrams on one page. How long Pele and Mermaid.js each take to draw the last one, in your browser. (markdown: https://pele.wiki/md/docs-page.md)
- [Untrusted input](https://pele.wiki/pages/safety.html): Demo: give Pele Mermaid text with script tags, javascript: links and oversized input, and see what reaches the page. (markdown: https://pele.wiki/md/safety.md)
- [Gallery](https://pele.wiki/pages/gallery.html): All 32 Mermaid diagram types drawn by Pele: flowchart, sequence, class, Gantt, sankey, C4, Wardley and more. Editable, with Mermaid.js for comparison. (markdown: https://pele.wiki/md/gallery.md)

## Guides
- [What is Pele?](https://pele.wiki/pages/what-is-pele.html): Pele is an MIT-licensed Mermaid renderer by kepano for Obsidian: Mermaid text in, themeable SVG out, synchronous, zero dependencies, about 230 kB gzip. (markdown: https://pele.wiki/md/what-is-pele.md)
- [Getting started with Pele](https://pele.wiki/pages/getting-started.html): Install Pele from npm, render Mermaid text to SVG with render(), mount a responsive diagram with mount(), and style it with CSS variables. (markdown: https://pele.wiki/md/getting-started.md)
- [Theming Pele diagrams](https://pele.wiki/pages/theming.html): Every Pele CSS variable for colours, fonts, corner radius and chart series, with light and dark mode examples and why colour changes need no redraw. (markdown: https://pele.wiki/md/theming.md)
- [Diagrams that fit phones](https://pele.wiki/pages/responsive.html): How Pele fits Mermaid diagrams to small screens: maxWidth, autoDirection and directionBreakpoint, mount() resizing, zoom, and when a diagram still needs room. (markdown: https://pele.wiki/md/responsive.md)
- [Diagrams in AI chat apps](https://pele.wiki/pages/streaming-ai.html): Render Mermaid from streaming AI answers with Pele: redraw on every chunk, keep the last good drawing, handle half-written lines, stay safe. (markdown: https://pele.wiki/md/streaming-ai.md)
- [Rendering untrusted diagrams safely](https://pele.wiki/pages/security.html): How Pele handles untrusted Mermaid: no scripts or HTML in its SVG, blocked javascript: links, size and edge limits, and the four things your app must still do. (markdown: https://pele.wiki/md/security.md)
- [Moving from Mermaid.js to Pele](https://pele.wiki/pages/migrating.html): Switch from Mermaid.js to Pele: the code swap, moving themeVariables to CSS, what looks different, what is not supported, and a safe fallback plan. (markdown: https://pele.wiki/md/migrating.md)
- [Pele API cheatsheet](https://pele.wiki/pages/api.html): One-page Pele API reference: render, mount, update, parse, supports, detectType, register, renderAsync, PeleError codes and the most useful options. (markdown: https://pele.wiki/md/api.md)

## Comparison
- [Pele vs Mermaid.js](https://pele.wiki/pages/pele-vs-mermaid.html): Pele and Mermaid.js side by side: syntax, render speed, bundle size, theming, narrow screens, safety, and what only Mermaid.js does. (markdown: https://pele.wiki/md/pele-vs-mermaid.md)

## FAQ
- [FAQ](https://pele.wiki/pages/faq.html): Answers about Pele: what it is, who made it, Mermaid compatibility, speed, size, theming, phones, safety, Node, licence, and when to keep Mermaid.js. (markdown: https://pele.wiki/md/faq.md)
